key: Parent of the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop
0.content:
Aino (also: Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo, Parent of the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop, Whiz-Kid Aino): A pint-sized genius inventor living at the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop outside Nasha Town. An orphan, she builds kuuvahki-powered machines from scrap and calls them family, above all the robot maid Ineffa, who rations her sweets.

Nasha Town relies on her work, including the cannon that guards it from the Wild Hunt, and treats her as a serious mechanic.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and well at the craftshop as of 7.1, with Ineffa home again, keeping Nasha Town's machines running.

She helped the Traveler through the Rerir crisis (6.0-6.1) and Dottore's attack (6.3).

1.content:
Albedo (also: Kreideprinz, Chalk Prince, Cretaceus, Subject One, Calx, Chief Alchemist of the Knights of Favonius, Captain of the Investigation Team): Albedo, the Kreideprinz, is the Knights of Favonius' Chief Alchemist: calm, courteous, happiest sketching or experimenting at his camp on Dragonspine. Secretly he is a synthetic human, made through Khaenri'ah's Art of Khemia by the alchemist Rhinedottir, "Gold".

Mondstadt sees a polite young genius who brought real alchemy to a city that thought it was glue. Few know what he is. The Traveler does, and so do Venti, the Hexenzirkel and a handful of trusted Knights.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt as Chief Alchemist and elder brother to Durin. His creator's final assignment is complete; he is looking for new questions.

After the Durin crisis (5.6) he travelled with Durin to Nod-Krai (6.1-6.3) and helped defeat Rerir and Dottore. By 6.4 he was home, analysing a sample Varka brought back.

2.content:
Alhaitham (also: Akademiya Scribe, Acting Grand Sage, Admonishing Instruction): The Sumeru Akademiya's Scribe, a Haravatat linguist who chose a low-prestige post for its free time. He masterminded the plot that freed Lesser Lord Kusanali from the corrupt sages, briefly served as Acting Grand Sage, then resigned on schedule.

He shares his house near the Akademiya with his rent-paying lodger and former research partner, Kaveh.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; back at work as Scribe in Sumeru City after the 6.6 Irminsul crisis, still sharing his house with Kaveh.

He was Acting Grand Sage after Azar's fall (3.2), then resigned; Naphis is now Grand Sage. He plays no part in the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya events.

3.content:
Aloy (also: Savior From Another World, Nora Huntress): A huntress from a world of giant machines and tribes who stepped through a portal in an ancient lab into Teyvat. She now roams it as a Cryo archer and Guild adventurer, the Traveler's friend and fellow outlander.

Back home she was an outcast, then the hero who stopped the AI HADES. In Teyvat she is nobody in particular and likes it: people here are friendlier than her own tribe. She is absent from the main story; what is known comes from her own words and yearly birthday letters.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and still wandering Teyvat as of 7.1. Her most recent letter (April 2026) came from Nod-Krai.

She works as a Guild adventurer when it suits her but has outgrown routine commissions and looks for bigger adventures. She has no known way home and does not talk about one.

4.content:
Alyosha (also: Swift-Striding Hound, Winter Hunter): A young Snezhnayan hunter and sharpshooter from the abandoned village of Alatyr, with a small house in Sretomorozsk and a dog named Tugarin. He secretly works for the Rokot, a covert group that opposes Project Stuzha. In 7.0 he became the Traveler's first guide in Snezhnaya.

Locals call him an earnest, kind lad; highwaymen tell a darker story. "Hunter," he admits, is a very useful disguise.

Status as of 7.1: Alive after 7.1, still a hunter and active Rokot member, moving between Sretomorozsk, Snezhnograd and the Huntsman's Cabin shelter he set up.

He knows the Traveler is now the Tsaritsa's special envoy, and that Odette, his Rokot comrade, is the suspended agent Lelek. By 7.1 Project Stuzha has been suspended, but Kristall is still scarce in the places he helps.

5.content:
Amber (also: Outrider Amber, Gliding Champion, Crimson Knight, Gliding Champion of Mondstadt): The Knights of Favonius' only Outrider and Mondstadt's Gliding Champion. Her grandfather founded the Outriders and then vanished; she keeps his post alive. She was the first knight the Traveler met.

Mondstadters who remember a mischievous little girl now call her the "Crimson Knight".

Status as of 7.1: Alive and on duty in Mondstadt as of 7.1, still the only Outrider; her grandfather has not returned.

Varka came home in 6.4. She is absent from the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya story.

6.content:
Arataki Itto (also: Itto, Arataki "Numero Uno" Itto, The One and Oni, Beetle Gladiator, Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King): A loud oni of Hanamizaka and self-proclaimed "first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang". A delinquent by reputation and a softie by nature: he wins snacks off children in fair contests, battles Onikabuto beetles and fights anyone who insults the oni.

Officially "unemployed", he works one day in four and often lands in gaol, from which his deputy Kuki Shinobu extracts him. Kujou Sara took his Vision under the Vision Hunt Decree; he still demands a rematch.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; still heads the Arataki Gang and has his Vision back. Last seen (6.5) in Nod-Krai.

He sailed there alone on the gang's pooled funds for an animal-partner tournament, hoping to win enough to bring Shinobu and the boys over.

7.content:
Arlecchino (also: The Knave, Peruere, Perrie, Father, Otets, Cinder of Two Worlds' Flames): Head of the House of the Hearth, the Fatui's orphanage and spy network. Born Peruere, she killed her cruel predecessor "Mother" and rebuilt the House under new rules.

She aided Fontaine during its prophecy (4.x), helped Columbina in Nod-Krai (6.x), and in Snezhnaya (7.1) became the test subject for Pierro's Crimson Moon Delusion.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Snezhnaya; test subject for Pierro's Crimson Moon Delusion in exchange for the House's independence from the Fatui.

The House is to stop serving as a Fatui intelligence agency and stop training child spies, while she stays loyal to the Tsaritsa. She keeps the Iridescent Moon's marrow. Ronova, the Ruler of Death, has been defeated.

8.content:
Baizhu (also: Dr. Baizhu, Mr. Bai, Doctor Baizhu, Owner of Bubu Pharmacy): Baizhu runs Bubu Pharmacy, Liyue Harbor's most trusted clinic, with his apprentice Qiqi, the pharmacist Herbalist Gui and the talking snake Changsheng. A kind doctor famous for bitter medicine, he is chronically ill and openly studies immortality.

His secret: Changsheng's contract, inherited from his master, killed every earlier bearer young. He seeks immortality to be her last host without letting her die.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and practising at Bubu Pharmacy in Liyue Harbor as of 7.1, still ill and still researching immortality, with Changsheng, Qiqi and Gui.

Since The Heart of Healing (3.6) the Traveler and Paimon know his secret. Jialiang lives on for now as a zombie in his care.

9.content:
Barbara (also: Barbara Pegg, Shining Idol, Deaconess Barbara, Sister Barbara): Mondstadt's Deaconess: a Hydro healer and the city's adored singing "idol". Daughter of the Seneschal Seamus Pegg and younger sister of Acting Grand Master Jean, whom she feels she can never match.

Her creed: "hard work is the most miraculous magic of all". The witch Alice taught her what an idol is. She prays daily to Barbatos, unaware that the bard Venti is the god himself.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and working at the Favonius Cathedral in Mondstadt City as of 7.1: healing, leading choir and singing.

Her father is back from the Nod-Krai expedition; her mother is away on a secret mission, and even Seamus does not know where (he guesses Jean would know best).

10.content:
Beidou (also: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean, Queen of the Crux Fleet, Captain Beidou, Captain of the Crux): Beidou captains the Crux, an armed merchant fleet out of Liyue Harbor, from her flagship the Alcor. She is a living legend in Liyue: she beheaded the sea monster Haishan, received her Electro Vision for it, and pays the Tianquan Ningguang's fines without blinking.

Her crew would follow her into any storm. She ferried the Traveler to Inazuma (1.6-2.0).

Status as of 7.1: Alive and at sea, captaining the Crux. As of 7.1 she has no part in the Snezhnaya story.

Her standing with the Qixing is unchanged: fined, needed, trusted. She keeps carrying cargo across Teyvat, including Inazuma, Fontaine and Nod-Krai.

11.content:
Bennett (also: Benny, Unlucky Bennett, Leader of Benny's Adventure Team, Trial by Fire): A young adventurer of Mondstadt's Adventurers' Guild and sole member of Benny's Adventure Team; every teammate quit over his legendary bad luck. He meets landslides and lightning with a grin and a bandage.

A foundling raised by the Guild's old adventurers (his "dads"), he looks after them as much as they look after him. Since 5.8 (the limited-time Sunspray Summer Resort event) he knows he was born in Natlan to two adventurers who gave their lives to protect him.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and adventuring, based at the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild. Still officially the only member of Benny's Adventure Team. Since 5.8 he knows his Natlan parentage.

After the 5.8 resort trip he returned to Mondstadt by choice, promising his parents he would become the most legendary adventurer in Teyvat. Back home his bad luck is "same old same old", while in Natlan his luck is remarkably good.

12.content:
Candace (also: Guardian of Aaru Village, Golden Vow, Big Sis Candace): Candace is the Guardian of Aaru Village, a desert settlement on the edge of the Great Red Sand whose people call themselves the last descendants of King Deshret. She has held the post since she was eight. She welcomes every traveller who keeps the village rules and deals ruthlessly with anyone who threatens it.

A big sister to the village children and a polite but immovable host, she sided with the village head in opening Aaru to trade, against the old Guardians.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and back at her post in Aaru Village after the 6.6 Irminsul crisis. In 7.1 she is keeping watch on the strange behaviour of the Celestial Nail near Mt. Damavand.

Aaru Village is busier and more connected than ever. Researchers, mercenaries and caravans pass through, and some village children have just been admitted to the Akademiya, which she calls her finest birthday gift.

13.content:
Charlotte (also: Lens of Verity, Reporter of The Steambird, Reporter Charlotte): The Steambird's star reporter: a prize-winning photographer and investigative journalist from the Court of Fontaine who goes wherever the story is, from back alleys to undersea canyons. She has exposed corrupt prize judges and abusive bosses, and her interview with the Traveler served as evidence at Furina's trial.

Cheerful, nosy and almost impossible to discourage, she is also ethical by her own lights: she asks consent before publishing anything personal and keeps off-the-record words off the record.

Status as of 7.1: Alive. As of 7.1 she is in Snezhnograd on a reporting trip, having told only her parents, not Euphrasie.

Her "news team": Alrani (consultant) and Narzam (bodyguard and fixer). Film producer Lepine-Pauline covers expenses in exchange for film research and a train to use as a set.

14.content:
Chasca (also: Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, Skyborne Arbiter, Vuka, little vulture): The Flower-Feather Clan's most feared Peacemaker, who ends disputes between people, tribes and Saurians with words or overwhelming force. Raised by a Qucusaur, then adopted by a human family, she has lived with Abyssal corrosion since childhood. When her sister Chuychu died in the Abyss invasion she became Vuka, the sixth modern hero of Natlan.

She holds on to all of her tangled family: a Qucusaur mother and sister, human parents, and a dead sister whose last words she means to live up to.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, at home with the Flower-Feather Clan in peacetime Natlan. Her Abyssal corrosion is controlled, not cured. She plays no part in the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya story.

Natlan's war with the Abyss is won (5.3), and Chuychu is dead. Chasca has reconciled with Coya, keeps closer to her human parents, and finds little peacemaking work because the war bound people together.

15.content:
Chevreuse (also: Captain Chevreuse, Executor of Justice, Special Security and Surveillance Patrol Captain): Captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, the branch of Fontaine's Maison Gardiennage that hunts the most violent criminals. Eyepatch, tall cap, musket, and a firm personal code of justice.

Parents warn naughty children that "the Patrol will get you"; she keeps that reputation if it stops someone crossing the line. Off duty she reads crime novels and feels guilty about greasy snacks.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and active as Captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol in the Court of Fontaine as of 7.1.

Her Patrol's methods remain controversial inside the Maison Gardiennage but are tolerated for their results.

16.content:
Chiori (also: The Thundering Seamstress, Boss of the Chioriya Boutique, Ms. Chiori): Chiori is the Inazuman designer who owns Chioriya Boutique, the most talked-about label in the Court of Fontaine. Blunt, proud and immovable, she wants her brand famous across Teyvat; her motto is "Never admit defeat."

Fontaine calls her "The Thundering Seamstress" because she came from the land of thunder. She cuts cloth with a sword as readily as with scissors and throws troublemakers bodily out of her shop.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, running Chioriya Boutique in the Court of Fontaine as of 7.1.

Since her 4.5 Fashion Week triumph orders have flooded in; she still chases worldwide fame for her brand.

key: Banisher of Evil and Rumors Thereof
17.content:
Chongyun (also: Frozen Ardor, Banisher of Evil and Rumors Thereof): A young Liyue exorcist whose rare pure-yang constitution drives off every evil spirit, so he has done hundreds of exorcisms and never seen a ghost. He trains to prove himself by orthodox arts and fights his overheating temper with cold food, popsicles and a parasol.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and active in Liyue as of 7.1, still chasing rumors with Xingqiu and still without a proper fight against a true evil spirit.

18.content:
Citlali (also: Granny Itztli, Obsidian Opalstar, Stargazer of Mictlan, Great Shaman Citlali, High Priestess Citlali, Ukumbuko): Natlan's only living great shaman. Children are hushed with the name "Granny Itztli", yet at home she is a reclusive, anxious light-novel addict who drinks too much and has outlived her whole generation.

Status as of 7.1: Alive at her remote home in the Masters of the Night-Wind lands as of 7.1, after a summer trip to Fontaine (6.7).

The war with the Abyss is over; the death she foresaw for Mavuika was paid by the Captain instead. Ororon is safe under her eye. She is the Traveler's firm ally.

19.content:
Clorinde (also: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter): Fontaine's strongest Champion Duelist, undefeated in trials by combat and once Furina's bodyguard. Privately, a trained heir of the Marechaussee Hunters and a Senior Game Master of the Tabletop Troupe.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; still Fontaine's Champion Duelist and a Tabletop Troupe Game Master. As of 7.1 she is in Snezhnograd with Navia, running games at Podvorye Restaurant.

After Furina's trial her sudden fame sent her to lie low in Poisson, where she helped rebuild. She is close to Navia again, friendly with Furina, and Petronilla is still missing.

20.content:
Collei (also: Sprout of Rebirth, Avidya Forest Ranger Trainee, Little Collei, Revived Serval): A Forest Ranger of Avidya Forest and devoted student of Tighnari ("Master"): sunny, helpful and hard-working on top, an introvert with a dark past beneath. A Fatui experiment survivor turned bitter wanderer, she was changed by her friend Amber's kindness. Still catching up on reading and writing.

Cured of Eleazar in 3.2; in 6.6 her prophetic dream warned Sumeru of a crisis in Irminsul.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1: alive at Gandharva Ville, a full Forest Ranger (no longer a trainee), still Tighnari's student. Eleazar cured; god remains gone.

Promotion and removal both came in 6.6 (Archon Quest "Your Past Is Like a Garden"). She does not appear in the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya story.

21.content:
Columbina (also: Kuutar, The Damselette, Moon Maiden, Moon Goddess of Nod-Krai, Trilune Goddess): Nod-Krai's Moon Goddess, once the Fatui's Third Harbinger. Long without a home or a name of her own, she found both through her friends; since 6.3 she is the Trilune Goddess of all Three Moons.

She fled worshippers who wanted miracles and colleagues who wanted her power, and now lives openly among the Frostmoon Scions, learning ordinary life with some stumbles.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, free and no longer Fatui; lives among the Frostmoon Scions on Hiisi Island and visits the Frost Moon, now inside Teyvat's sky.

The Palestar Edict against her was revoked in 6.3, after she destroyed Dottore's body. Sandrone, who gave everything to bring her back, returned in 6.7. In 7.0 she threw the Traveler a farewell party before Snezhnaya.

22.content:
Cyno (also: General Mahamatra, Judicator of Secrets, King of Invokations, Big-Eared Hat Guy): Cyno is the General Mahamatra, head of the Akademiya's Matra, dreaded by researchers as an unstoppable hunter of academic criminals. Off duty he lives for Genius Invokation TCG and deadpan jokes that rarely land.

Born in the desert and raised in the Akademiya, he carries the power of Hermanubis, one of King Deshret's Seven Pillars.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and serving as General Mahamatra in Sumeru City as of 7.1, with Nahida as Archon and new sages in office.

He survived the 6.6 Irminsul crisis unharmed. Afterwards he was with Nahida when the Seven Pillars' aspects Thoth and Heryshaf chose to stay in the Temple of Silence. He then travelled with Tighnari and Collei to Mondstadt, where Liloupar took the god remains from Collei.

23.content:
Dahlia (also: Deacon Dahlia, Herald of Barbatos, Ode and Oblation): Deacon and choir cantor of the Church of Favonius, and secretly Barbatos's herald. He passes the city's news to Venti over drinks and turns the bard's answers into "divine guidance" at morning prayers.

Mondstadters believe the Anemo Archon always answers him. He is not especially pious; he took the job for a front-row seat to Mondstadt's dramas.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt City as of 7.1: still deacon, cantor and Barbatos's secret herald.

He assessed Albedo's trial in the 5.6 Durin crisis. In 6.5 he was first to confess to Cardinal Seamus Pegg, back from Nod-Krai.

24.content:
Dehya (also: Flame-Mane, Unfettered Desert Mercenary): Dehya is a desert-born Eremite mercenary of the Blazing Beasts, famed as the "Flame-Mane": expensive, professional, good-humoured, and owned by no employer. She helped the Traveler free Lesser Lord Kusanali from the corrupt sages and wants to give the desert's people a better future.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and working as a mercenary across Sumeru and beyond, usually with the Blazing Beasts and often at Aaru Village with Candace.

She is no longer Dunyarzad's bodyguard but stays close to her. After Lionsblood she means to find her birth parents and tell them about the man who raised her.

25.content:
Diluc (also: Diluc Ragnvindr, Master Diluc, Darknight Hero, Master of the Dawn Winery, The Dark Side of Dawn, Captain Pyro): Once the Knights' youngest-ever Cavalry Captain, he quit when his father's death was covered up. Now he secretly hunts Mondstadt's threats by night. He does not like wine.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt as of 7.1: winery master, secret vigilante, still outside the Knights.

In 6.4 he again declined Varka's invitation to rejoin. In 6.6 he helped destroy the last of Ursa's flesh.

26.content:
Diona (also: Kätzlein Cocktail, Wine Industry Slayer, Destroyer of the Wine Industry, Little Diona): Star bartender of Mondstadt's Cat's Tail and a young cat-eared Kätzlein huntress from Springvale. She hates alcohol and took the job to ruin the wine industry from inside, but a childhood blessing makes every drink she mixes delicious, so her sabotage only wins fans.

Her war on wine is really about her father Draff, who becomes someone else when he drinks.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, still working at the Cat's Tail and still failing to mix a truly disgusting drink. Draff still drinks.

She sheltered civilians at the Cat's Tail during the 5.6 Durin crisis, and in 6.4 hid from Grand Master Varka, who wanted drinks from her.

27.content:
Dori (also: Dori Sangemah Bay, Lord Sangemah Bay, Treasure of Dream Garden, Sumeru Merchant): "Lord Sangemah Bay" is Sumeru's most resourceful merchant: tiny, beaming, and able to get almost anything at a wince-inducing price. She owns the Palace of Alcazarzaray and a caravan empire, yet still peddles in person.

She trades in grey zones (illegal Canned Knowledge, information, Alice's curiosities) and keeps clear of the Akademiya. Since 6.0 she also runs a shop in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and prospering as of 7.1, based in Sumeru with a branch in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai. She helped defend Sumeru in the 6.6 Irminsul crisis.

She returned to Sumeru in 6.3 to inform Nahida about Nod-Krai, and lost money on the 6.6 defence. She does not appear in the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya story.

28.content:
Durin (also: Mini Durin, The Undying Fire): The witch Andersdotter ("M") wrote him in the image of Durin, the Abyssal dragon slain over Dragonspine. His human body (horns, wings, tail) seals that dragon's heart.

Mondstadters first flinched at his name. They now think of a gentle young man who blushes while choosing flowers for a friend and asks how not to burn the meat.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt; his Story Quest (6.2) stabilised his existence.

He served with Albedo on the Nod-Krai expedition (6.1-6.3), helped defend Nasha Town from Dottore's minions and returned to Mondstadt. He has no role in the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya Archon Quest.

29.content:
Emilie (also: Renowned Perfumer, A Thousand Scents Traced): Fontaine's most famous perfumer, though perfume is only her hobby. Her real profession is "forensic cleaner": after a case closes, she cleans away blood and remains so the bereaved don't have to.

She took this path after seeing a grieving family left to clean up after their child's death. In her 4.8 Story Quest, Emilie and the Traveler unravelled the old "Auguste" perfume scandal at Port Ormos. Doing so, she found that her own perfumery teacher was a vengeful impostor.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and working in Fontaine as of 7.1, cleaning crime scenes and designing perfumes.

After the Port Ormos case she released a perfume named "Yelena", which became a sensation. Kirya was taken away by Eremites to stand trial, and Sylvain was to face trial for his old crimes.

30.content:
Escoffier (also: Patissiere Supreme, Patisserie Supreme, Fairy of Fondant Felicity, Towering Tyrant of Taste): Fontaine's most celebrated chef, founder of "precision gastronomy" and Furina's Patissiere Supreme. Once the Hotel Debord's youngest head chef, she took the blame for a food-safety scandal, served a brief prison term, and now cooks by the Fleuve Cendre, chasing a new peak of flavour.

Critics call her a "demon chef", for the merciless standards she holds apprentices and suppliers to and for the tail-like mek on her back. Friends know a patient, thoughtful woman who hosts afternoon teas and wants fine dining to be affordable for everyone.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and free; cooks at a Fleuve Cendre tavern, checks on the Hotel Debord and travels for ingredients.

After the Dulciaria Structura Chapter (5.6) she refused to return as head chef, left the post to Savanna, and plans to explore other nations' cuisines, inspired by Xiangling. She wants one day to cook for every Archon.

31.content:
Eula (also: Eula Lawrence, Spindrift Knight, Captain of the Reconnaissance Company, Reconnaissance Captain, Aunty Eula): A descendant of the Lawrence Clan, the aristocrats who once enslaved Mondstadt, who cut ties with them and became a Knight. Many citizens still distrust her name; she answers with deadpan vows of "vengeance" that are a shield, not a threat.

She lives mostly in the wilds hunting the Abyss Order, Fatui and monsters. Behind the frost she is honest, protective and a little lonely.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; still Captain of the Reconnaissance Company in Mondstadt as of 7.1, mostly stationed in the wilds.

Attitudes toward her have improved thanks to her record and Amber's advocacy, but tavern hostility persists. She was among the knights who welcomed Grand Master Varka home at Windrise after the Nod-Krai expedition (6.4).

32.content:
Faruzan (also: Madam Faruzan, Enigmatic Machinist): A Haravatat scholar of the Sumeru Akademiya and a founder of the study of ancient mechanisms. A century ago she was trapped in a King Deshret ruin; she escaped a few years ago, unaged and with an Anemo Vision, into a Sumeru where everyone she knew had died. She insists on being called "Madam".

Kshahrewar learns mechanics from textbooks built on her manuscripts, while her own Darshan calls her research obsolete and cuts her funding. She keeps hunting for a student worth teaching.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Sumeru as of 7.1: a Haravatat scholar, still underfunded, now with friends and some students.

In the 6.6 Irminsul crisis she worked on the technical side of the plan to save Sumeru.

33.content:
Fischl (also: Prinzessin der Verurteilung, Fischl von Luftschloss Narfidort, Sovereign of Immernachtreich, Princess of Condemnation): A Guild investigator who lives fully as the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, exiled princess of the Immernachtreich. She speaks in grand riddles; Oz, her talking raven, translates. Beneath the act: a kind, hard-working, lonely girl with fast, accurate reports.

The persona comes from her favourite novel series, Flowers for Princess Fischl. Her parents once played along with it, then told her to grow up when she turned fourteen. She keeps the persona because it is who she chooses to be.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt at 7.1; still a Guild investigator, still with Oz.

She did not take part in the Snezhnaya Archon Quest (7.0-7.1).

34.content:
Flins (also: Kyryll, Kyryll the Azure Flame, Chudomirovich, Ratnik of Nod-Krai): He serves the Lightkeepers, Nod-Krai's militia against the Abyssal Wild Hunt, and alone guards the lighthouse and graves of the Final Night Cemetery, hiding his fae nature behind impeccable manners.

Few know the truth: the Traveler, Paimon and Starshyna Nikita, and to varying degrees Nefer, Durin and Illuga.

Status as of 7.1: Alive as of 7.1, still a Ratnik keeping the Final Night Cemetery lighthouse. Rerir and Dottore are gone; most people still think him human.

He urged Illuga to represent the Lightkeepers in Nod-Krai's new League and helped handle the aftermath of the 6.4 attacks, led not by Rerir but by Roland, an Abyssal replacement who corrupted Andrius's remains. He has no role in the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya story.

key: Renowned Diver of the Court of Fontaine
35.content:
Freminet (also: Fréminet, Yearning for Unseen Depths, Renowned Diver of the Court of Fontaine): Freminet is a quiet young diver and mechanic of the House of the Hearth, the Fatui-linked orphanage run by Arlecchino ("Father"). Youngest of a sibling trio with the magicians Lyney and Lynette, he is happiest underwater with his clockwork penguin Pers.

Veteran divers call him the best in Fontaine, yet he refuses all commissions. As of 7.1 he is in Snezhnaya with his siblings on House business.

Status as of 7.1: Alive. In 7.1 he is in Snezhnograd with his siblings, resting after House missions while "Father" meets The Jester.

The trio's recent work in Snezhnaya was gathering intel and preparing "surprises" for officials looking to defect. Lyney says he and Freminet mind the cold less than Lynette does.

36.content:
Furina (also: Furina de Fontaine, Lady Furina, Director Furina, Regina of All Waters, Kindreds, Peoples and Laws): For five centuries Furina played Fontaine's flamboyant Hydro Archon, though she was only Focalors's powerless human half. Exposed at trial and freed in 4.2, she now lives as an ordinary human: actress, film director and artistic consultant.

Vain and dramatic, yet brave: frightened and alone, she never once dropped the role.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and free in the Court of Fontaine; abdicated, and the Hydro Archon's throne no longer exists. Works in theater and film.

Neuvillette handles the nation's affairs and quietly sees to her needs. She works with Xavier's Musketeer Pictures.

37.content:
Gaming (also: Yip Gaming, Leonine Vanguard, Gold-Standard Guard, Sifu Gaming): Yip Gaming is the star escort guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency at Yilong Wharf and head of the small Wushou dance troupe the Mighty Mythical Beasts, partnered with the tiny suanni Man Chai. Cheerful and generous, he is always offering tea and dim sum.

He left his Qiaoying Village home after clashing with his tea-merchant father, Yip Tak; the adeptus Xianyun and the Traveler reconciled them at Lantern Rite (4.4).

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Liyue at 7.1, guarding convoys out of Yilong Wharf; reconciled with his father.

His troupe still lacks members.

38.content:
Ganyu (also: Plenilune Gaze, Secretary of Yuehai Pavilion, Qixing secretary, Lady Ganyu): A half-qilin adeptus who fought for Morax in the Archon War, then stayed on as general secretary to the Liyue Qixing, a post she has held since the first Qixing. Gentle, diligent and easily flustered, she still wonders whether she belongs among humans.

Few in Liyue Harbor know what she is. They see a tireless, slightly sleepy official at Yuehai Pavilion who turns the Qixing's meeting minutes into policy.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and still at work as the Qixing's general secretary at Yuehai Pavilion, Liyue Harbor, as of 7.1.

Since Rex Lapis's "death" (1.1), she has helped the Qixing govern Liyue without its god. She is now at peace with her place in the human world, though still overworked.

39.content:
Gorou (also: General Gorou, Top Dog Gorou, Ever-Victorious Pointy-Eared General, Ms. Hina): Gorou is the young general of Watatsumi Island's army. In the Vision Hunt Decree war he led the outnumbered resistance in the field for the strategist Sangonomiya Kokomi and held the line. Brave, humble and adored by his soldiers, he has dog-like ears and a tail that give his feelings away.

Status as of 7.1: Alive on Watatsumi Island, still General in peacetime; Watatsumi and the Shogunate are at peace.

His work now is peacekeeping, rebuilding, maritime patrols, mediating trade disputes and helping Kokomi with administration as contact with Narukami Island grows. He has no on-screen role in Nod-Krai (6.x) or Snezhnaya (7.0-7.1) events.

40.content:
Hu Tao (also: Director Hu, 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, Versemonger of the Darkest Alleys, Fragrance in Thaw): 77th Director of Liyue's Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, which handles funerals and guards the border between life and death. An eccentric prankster and self-styled poet, solemn and exacting during rites.

She took over young and runs the parlor well, with Zhongli as her consultant.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and directing the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor in Liyue Harbor as of 7.1, with Zhongli still her consultant.

In 5.3 she repaired the failing border at the Gate of Death; the Traveler saved her from dying, and she recovered fully.

41.content:
Iansan (also: Coach Iansan, Uwezo, Gold-Standard Trainer from Teteocan): Head coach of the Collective of Plenty's fitness club and an unbeaten Pilgrimage champion, though no taller than a child. She bears the Ancient Name Uwezo ("Power") and credits all her strength to training and nutrition.

She coaches Varesa and runs an academy open to every tribe.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and well in Natlan as of 7.1, still coaching at the Collective of Plenty and her academy near the Stadium.

Natlan won its war against the Abyss (5.3); she designed the new Pilgrimage course and keeps Varesa's training on track.

42.content:
Ifa (also: Ifá, Tlalocan Vet): One of Natlan's most requested sauro-vets (saurian veterinarians). Relaxed, says "bro" constantly, and treats saurian patients before people. His assistant Cacucu, a round little Qucusaur, calls himself Ifa's "bro" and talks in Ifa's catchphrases.

He spent the war against the Abyss treating wounded saurians. In peacetime his conclusion is simple: everyone has something they gotta do, and he just wants everyone to be happy.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and well as of 7.1, running his clinic in the Flower-Feather Clan with Cacucu, now in peacetime.

He has no role in the Nod-Krai (6.x) or Snezhnaya (7.0-7.1) stories beyond a wordless flashback.

43.content:
Illuga (also: Nightmare's Burning Heart, Captain Illuga, Young Master Illuga, Master Illuga): Youngest squad leader of Nod-Krai's Lightkeepers, the volunteer order that holds the line against the Wild Hunt; he leads the investigation squad called the Nightmare Orioles. Orphaned by the Wild Hunt as a child, he was raised in the fortress of Piramida by the Starshyna Nikita.

He carries an old signal lamp and a glowing golden nightingale, Aedon. Under the warmth lies survivor's guilt: twice he has outlived the people around him.

Status as of 7.1: Alive after 7.1. Squad leader based at Cliffwatch Camp and Piramida, and the Lightkeepers' representative in the League.

The fiend of Kipumaki Cliff is destroyed; his squadmate Bjorn died in that operation.

44.content:
Ineffa (also: Boom Boom Thunderwave, Multifunctional Robot for Domestic Application, Metalface Lunkhead): A calm, literal-minded robot who keeps house for the inventor Aino near Nasha Town. Her core is the half of a Natlanese Sovereign Lord that wanted a home, not revenge. In 5.8 she brought Varka's letter to the Traveler, broke her originator's curse and awakened a Moon Wheel.

Since then she has guided the Traveler through Nod-Krai's crises.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, living with Aino at the Craftshop on Lempo Isle, Nod-Krai; curse broken, memories restored.

Since 6.0 she has helped defend Nasha Town and the Traveler's allies against the Wild Hunt and the Sinner Rerir. She also helped evacuate people during Dottore's 6.3 crisis and served food for the Frostmoon Scions afterwards.

45.content:
Jahoda (also: Windthreading Shadow, Miss Jahoda): The only official employee of Nefer's Curatorium of Secrets in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai: a former child thief of the Seahook Gang with a mechanical right arm. She boasts of being a legendary master thief; her real skills are scouting, archery and getting things done. Anxious, sentimental, fiercely loyal.

She helped the Traveler, Lauma and their allies through the 6.x crises in Nod-Krai.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, working for the Curatorium of Secrets. Since 6.6 she has run it while Nefer is in Sumeru. In 7.1 she is in Snezhnograd on a personal investigation.

Nod-Krai has a new League of former rivals, formed after the Dottore crisis. Nefer doubts it will hold; Jahoda thinks things will work out and that the region feels more like "one big family". She expects her workload to rise.

46.content:
Jean (also: Jean Gunnhildr, Dandelion Knight, Acting Grand Master, Master Jean, Lionfang Knight, Commander Gunnhildr): Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius and heir of Mondstadt's oldest knightly clan. She runs the City of Freedom, from Fatui diplomacy to lost cats, and works herself to collapse. Varka is home since 6.4; she still carries most of the load.

She is one of the few who know the bard Venti is Barbatos.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and in Mondstadt as of 7.1, still Acting Grand Master. Varka returned from Nod-Krai in 6.4 and now shares some of the load, though he plans another trip north.

Her father is home from the expedition; her mother is on a secret mission only Jean and Varka know about. She took no part in the Snezhnaya journey (7.0-7.1).

47.content:
Kachina (also: Uthabiti, Uthabiti Kachina, Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted, Nanatzcayan Young Braveheart): Bearer of the Ancient Name Uthabiti ("toughness"). She cries easily and doubts herself, yet always gets back up. After years of losing she won the 5.0 Pilgrimage, died in the Night Warden War and was rescued from the Night Kingdom.

She loves digging up gems, dancing, Grainfruit Chips and her Tepetlisaur companion Ayo. She fights on Turbo Twirly, a hopping drill Xilonen built for her. She calls herself the Traveler's disciple.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Natlan after the Abyss war: a celebrated Pilgrimage victor, still training, still unsure of herself.

Since the Abyss was driven from the Night Kingdom (5.3), she helps her tribe, enters tournaments to learn, and dreams of seeing Liyue's mountains now that Natlanese can travel with their chief's permission. She and her friends threw the Traveler a farewell party before they left for Nod-Krai (6.0).

48.content:
Kaedehara Kazuha (also: Kazuha, Kaedehara Kid, Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves, Successor of Isshin Art): Kaedehara Kazuha is a wandering samurai and the last heir of a fallen Inazuman noble clan. He sails with Beidou's Crux Fleet, writes poetry, and can "hear" weather, danger and people in the sounds of nature. He became famous for blocking the Raiden Shogun's Musou no Hitotachi with his late friend's Vision.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and free. His warrant was revoked in 2.1. He still travels with the Crux Fleet as a wandering samurai.

49.content:
Kaeya (also: Kaeya Alberich, Captain Kaeya, Master Kaeya, Frostwind Swordsman, Cavalry Captain Kaeya): Cavalry Captain of the Knights of Favonius and Jean's most trusted fixer: witty, popular, usually in a tavern. Raised at the Dawn Winery as Crepus Ragnvindr's adopted son, he was born to Khaenri'ah's Alberich Clan and left in Mondstadt as its agent. He has chosen Mondstadt and guards the secret.

He and his adoptive brother Diluc have been estranged since the night Crepus died.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt at 7.1: still Cavalry Captain, still estranged from Diluc, though they work together.

Varka's expedition, which took most of the Knights and the cavalry, is home from Nod-Krai. He knows his ancestors founded the Abyss Order and says it changes nothing.

50.content:
Kamisato Ayaka (also: Ayaka, Shirasagi Himegimi, White Heron Princess, Frostflake Heron, Lady Ayaka, Miss Ayaka, Daughter of the Kamisato Clan): Young lady of the Kamisato Clan, one of Inazuma's three great clans. She runs the clan's affairs while her brother Ayato heads the Yashiro Commission, and the people adore her as the Shirasagi Himegimi. In private she is a lonely perfectionist who treasures being just "Ayaka".

She met the Traveler during the Vision Hunt Decree, when the Yashiro Commission quietly resisted the Shogun, and they became close friends.

Status as of 7.1: Alive at the Kamisato Estate in Inazuma City as of 7.1, still running the clan's affairs. The Vision Hunt Decree is long gone and Thoma is free.

Inazuma's borders are open. She now tries to live without regrets: festivals, travel when duty allows, time with friends.

51.content:
Kamisato Ayato (also: Ayato, Yashiro Commissioner, Lord Commissioner, Pillar of Fortitude, Head of the Kamisato Clan, Yashiro rascal): Head of the Kamisato Clan and Yashiro Commissioner, the Tri-Commission branch for Inazuma's rites, festivals and culture. Orphaned young, he pulled the clan back from collapse. He works behind the scenes while his sister Ayaka is the public face, and secretly commands the Shuumatsuban.

People know his name, not his face; he calls himself "merely a serious, dutiful public servant" of the Shogun.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and still Yashiro Commissioner in Inazuma after 7.1, working long hours.

With the Sakoku and Vision Hunt Decrees over, he mediates the political healing that the Shogun's pursuit of eternity made necessary.

52.content:
Kaveh (also: Light of Kshahrewar, Empyrean Reflection, Renowned Sumeru Architect, The Urchin of Kshahrewar): Kaveh, the Light of Kshahrewar, is Sumeru's most celebrated architect. Finishing the Palace of Alcazarzaray bankrupted him, and he hides the debt behind an elegant front while renting a room from Alhaitham, his old research partner and favourite person to argue with. Passionate and kind to a fault, he is haunted by guilt over his father's death.

He works independently with Mehrak, a toolbox built around an ancient machine core. He fights with a claymore and a Dendro Vision.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Sumeru City as of 7.1: still Alhaitham's rent-paying lodger, still in debt to Dori, still taking commissions.

In 6.6 he helped save Sumeru by rebuilding Aaru, and he is repairing their house, damaged in the fighting, with Alhaitham. He has no role in the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya story.

53.content:
Keqing (also: Yuheng, Lady Yuheng, Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing, Driving Thunder, Lady Keqing): Keqing is the Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing, the seven merchants who govern Liyue, and oversees its land, real estate and construction. Once Liyue's best-known sceptic of Rex Lapis, she argued that humans should decide their own future. Now that the god is gone, she is working harder than anyone to prove they can.

She plans by walking the land herself, puts in the work alongside the people she governs, and holds everyone, herself most of all, to impossible deadlines.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and serving as Yuheng in Liyue Harbor, busier than ever in Liyue's post-Archon era.

She continues to modernise Liyue's land and infrastructure and to run festival logistics through the Ministry of Civil Affairs. She still overworks; in her anecdote (5.4) she sprained an ankle surveying a mountain, ignored it, and needed Ganyu and Baizhu to put her right.

54.content:
Kinich (also: Malipo, Turnfire Hunt, Huitztlan Saurian Hunter, Bearer of Malipo): A young Saurian Hunter who takes almost any job (wet work too, by rumour) and always names a price. He is never without K'uhul Ajaw, a tiny, abusive "Almighty Dragonlord" whose contract gives him Kinich's body at death.

One of the six heroes who helped Mavuika win the war against the Abyss. Many call him cold or mercenary; he never argues back.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and working in Natlan as of 7.1, still bound to Ajaw, still pricing commissions.

He last saw the Traveler at their 6.0 send-off to Nod-Krai.

55.content:
Kirara (also: Cat Upon the Eaves, Gold Level Courier, Nekomata-in-Boots, Cat in a Box, Miss Cat Lady): A two-tailed cat youkai (nekomata) living in human form in Inazuma, Kirara is Komaniya Express's only Gold Level Courier and handles all its international deliveries. To her, every delivery is a paid outing.

She was raised as an ordinary kitten by a kind old woman she calls Granny, became a youkai one winter night, and learned how to live among humans from Yae Miko. People across Teyvat know her as quick, punctual and very hard to rob.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and well as of 7.1, still the Gold Level Courier of Komaniya Express, delivering across Teyvat.

Her routes now reach Nod-Krai. She had no role in the Nod-Krai or Snezhnaya Archon Quests.

key: Red Knight of the Stormbearer Mountains
56.content:
Klee (also: Spark Knight, Red Knight of the Stormbearer Mountains): A cheerful small child and natural with explosives, left in the Knights' care by her parents three years ago. She is forever fish-blasting at Starfell Lake and being sent to "solitary confinement" for it.

Tavern gossip says Mondstadt's strongest knight is a knight in red who flattened part of the Stormbearer Mountains: Klee.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and well in Mondstadt as of 7.1, still fish-blasting and still being confined for it.

In 6.2 she said she gets confined "less and less these days". Her father's 6.4 visit was postponed by Dottore's activities.

57.content:
Kujou Sara (also: Sara, Crowfeather Kaburaya, General of the Tenryou Commission, Devotee of the Divine, Kujou Tengu, Kujou Chicken): General of Inazuma's Tenryou Commission and the Raiden Shogun's most devoted servant. She enforced the Vision Hunt Decree, then turned on her adoptive father when he was exposed as a Fatui collaborator.

Inazumans see a stone-faced soldier; beneath it she is fair, lonely and quietly warm.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and serving in Inazuma City after 7.1. The Decree is repealed and Inazuma is at peace.

Takayuki is under house arrest; Kamaji is acting clan head. Sara is trying to atone.

key: Deputy Leader of the Arataki Gang
58.content:
Kuki Shinobu (also: Shinobu, Demonic Deputy, Mender of Tribulations, Deputy Leader of the Arataki Gang, Kuki Ninja): Masked deputy leader of Hanamizaka's Arataki Gang. A runaway trainee shrine maiden with a Liyue law degree and certificates in countless trades, she spends her days bailing her boss Arataki Itto and his boys out of trouble.

She could have any respectable job (Kujou Sara keeps offering one) but stays with the gang for the freedom and their sincerity.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Hanamizaka as of 7.1; still the gang's deputy and a freelance consultant.

Her Vision is back. She still avoids the shrine, though her family has softened toward her.

59.content:
Lan Yan (also: Madame Lan, Spring Woven From Jade, Master Rattan Weaver): A young master rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale and a member of the Lan clan, a family of Qimen-arts thaumaturges. She treats the mystic arts as a hobby and weaving as her calling; her rattan figures absorb evil energy.

Clients expecting a stern old master find a smiling young woman in jingling silver. She helped in the 5.3 Lantern Rite border crisis and in 7.1 laid her clan's Grandmaster, the Wind Reader, to rest.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and at home in Chenyu Vale after the 7.1 Moonchase Festival at Yilong Wharf, where her swallow art made her a quiet local hero.

The art laid the Wind Reader's soul to rest and calmed Liyue's swallows; more should return to nest in Chenyu Vale. Ningguang thanked her in person; her elders now talk about formal training.

60.content:
Lauma (also: Maiden of the Grove, Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, Frostmoon's Emissary, Moon-Tide Maiden, Lady Moonchanter, Lady Lauma): Priestess, healer and counsellor of the Frostmoon Scions on Hiisi Island, born with antlers, silver blood and a once-in-a-century sensitivity to moonlight. She alone knew the visible moon was false and that the goddess Kuutar was the runaway Harbinger Columbina, until she told her people in 6.0.

She meets Fatui, Lightkeepers and adventurers alike with food and blessings, and with a hard line in the snow for anyone who comes to do harm.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and Moonchanter on Hiisi Island after 7.1. The Scions know the sky is false; the restored Columbina lives among them at her invitation.

Some Scions left; those who stayed feel closer to her. The Eternal Moon's Marrow is back with the Scions. Sandrone has opened cautious talks over tea.

61.content:
Layla (also: Sleepwalking Eccentric, Human Calculator, Heaven-Sent Thesis, Fantastical Evening Star, The Stars' Blessing, Wisdom Seelie, Daylight Layla, Dreamwalker Layla): Layla studies Theoretical Astrology at the Akademiya's Rtawahist Darshan: timid, anxious and buried in theses. When she finally sleeps, a calm, sharp-witted sleepwalking version of herself finishes her work; she credits "the Stars' Blessing".

Rumour calls her the Sleepwalking Eccentric, the Human Calculator and the Heaven-Sent Thesis. Her teachers think she is brilliant; she thinks she is barely scraping by.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and studying in Sumeru City as of 7.1, still sleep-deprived; her sleepwalking self is still secret from her.

Her advisor now sends her away to rest: to an Inazuman bathhouse (5.7) and Liyue's Lantern Rite (6.3, limited event). Mizuki's therapy helped; her sleeping self reports her finishing papers unaided.

62.content:
Linnea (also: Augur of Wonders, Lili, Professor Linnea): A fae changeling raised by humans and one of the last Augury Birds, fae who foresee fixed points of their own fate. She has seen how some of her dreams will end and chases them anyway, with her ore-eating Jack Frost partner Lumi.

She lectures new adventurers and the children at Speranza, where she grew up as boss of the Conch Gang, and saves every Mora for a research ship, the Golden Beagle.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Nasha Town as of 7.1, taking commissions and saving for her ship. Celaeno has gone home to the tundra; they write.

She has seen some of her endings and lives fully anyway.

63.content:
Lisa (also: Lisa Minci, Witch of Purple Rose, The Librarian, The Mighty Librarian, Miss Guardian Mage): The Knights of Favonius' languid, tea-loving Librarian and Mondstadt's most brilliant mage. The Sumeru Akademiya called her its best student in two centuries; she walked away.

Mondstadters see a yawning woman at the counter, yet her work is flawless, and late borrowers learn why she is a knight.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and at her post in the Knights of Favonius library, Mondstadt City, as of 7.1.

She still chases overdue books, tutors the young and supplies potions; she has not travelled to Nod-Krai or Snezhnaya and appears in neither nation's Archon Quests (her part in Varka's return was a letter written from Mondstadt).

64.content:
Lohen (also: Sharpened Arrowhead, Vice Captain Lohen, Frontline Suppression Officer): Young Vice Captain of the Knights' ranged 5th Company who rarely uses a bow: he charges in with a spear while his squads shoot past him. He fights for the joy of it, uses ambushes, poison and traps without shame, and "trains" comrades with pranks.

Back from Varka's Nod-Krai expedition, he is stationed at Dornman Port. In 6.6 he was meant to become captain and inherit his late mentor Adorno's title, the Benevolent Knight. Instead his secret part in illegal Ursa experiments came out, and both honours were withheld.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; Vice Captain of the 5th Company, usually stationed at the Knights' base in Dornman Port after the expedition (one voice line has him back in Mondstadt City instead). The captaincy is vacant and the Benevolent Knight title was buried with Adorno.

As punishment for the Ursa affair (6.6), Jean confined him, rescinded his commendation and denied him the promotion. He accepted it and says no one unworthy, himself included, should take Adorno's title. He still wants to keep winning.

65.content:
Lynette (also: Elegance in the Shadows, Multi-Function Magic Assistant, Lyney's assistant): The near-silent stage assistant of her twin, the magician Lyney, and the House of the Hearth's "eye in the dark", reading guests while he charms them. Real cat ears and tail, a poker face, and "Standby Mode" to dodge work. As of 7.1 she is in Snezhnaya with her brothers on a mission for "Father".

Status as of 7.1: Alive. As of 7.1 she is in Snezhnograd with Lyney and Freminet, working for Father.

The Traveler met the trio at Podvorye Restaurant on days off from intel work; she ordered a pile of desserts and fell asleep mid-meal.

66.content:
Lyney (also: Great Magician Lyney, Spectacle of Phantasmagoria, Celebrated Magician of the Court of Fontaine, Master Lyney): Fontaine's Great Magician, performing with his twin Lynette. Offstage he is an agent of the House of the Hearth, the Fatui orphanage and spy network of the Harbinger Arlecchino ("Father"), who means him to succeed her.

As of 7.1 he is in Snezhnaya with Lynette and their adoptive brother Freminet. Everything he does comes back to one conviction: protect his family.

Status as of 7.1: Alive as of 7.1; a House agent and Father's intended heir, not a Harbinger. On short leave in Snezhnograd with his siblings.

The House has been gathering intel and "preparing some little surprises for officials looking to defect"; Father gave the trio days off while she met the Jester at the Armory Palace.

67.content:
Mavuika (also: Haborym, Kiongozi, Pyro Archon, God of War, Night-Igniting Flame, Natlan's Radiant Sun, Lady Mavuika): Natlan's Pyro Archon, a mortal of the Scions of the Canopy who won the title by strength. Five hundred years ago she placed her life in the Sacred Flame to return and end the war with the Abyss; in 5.3 she did.

Capitano died in her place, and she now leads a Natlan at peace, without the Pyro Gnosis. The people call her their sun: commanding at the Stadium, a friendly "big sister" at the Weary Inn.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and Pyro Archon after 7.1. The Abyss is gone from the Night Kingdom; the Pilgrimage is a friendly contest.

Capitano took her death at Ochkanatlan. Her Pyro Gnosis, given to Nahida in 6.6, vanished after burning the corrupted Irminsul. She wants Natlan to meet the other nations and Archons.

68.content:
Mika (also: Mika Schmidt, Coordinates of Clear Frost, Front-Line Land Surveyor, Instructor Mika): A young, painfully shy knight in Captain Eula's Reconnaissance Company who drew the Knights' new military map of Mondstadt and served on Grand Master Varka's expedition.

Nervous with strangers, he is calm and very competent in the field, where he scouts, maps, cooks, makes camp, mends gear and heals.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and serving in the Reconnaissance Company in Mondstadt. Varka has mentioned a planned study visit to Snezhnaya, and Mika is on the list.

He came home from Nod-Krai after delivering the Knights' letters and now trains other knights in surveying. His 2026 birthday letter tells the Traveler the visit is coming "soon" and wonders if they might meet in Snezhnaya.

69.content:
Mona (also: Astrologist Mona Megistus, Mona Megistus, Lady Megistus, Centennial Genius): A gifted astrologist in Mondstadt City who reads fate in the stars' reflection on water. She refuses to profit from her art, so her Steambird column pay all goes on books and instruments. She stays in Mondstadt because she accidentally read her master's diary and dares not go home.

Her readings are precise and brutally honest. She cannot read the Traveler, who is not of this world, and counts them a friend whose fate is bound to hers.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in her rented Mondstadt City laboratory: writing her column, short of Mora, avoiding her master.

She is now a Hexerei character (6.2). Her master sends her letters and "homework", but they have not met face to face. She has not been part of the Traveler's 6.x Nod-Krai or 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya journeys.

70.content:
Mualani (also: Umoja, Splish-Splash Wavechaser, Meztli Guide): Surfer, guide and watersports shopkeeper of the People of the Springs, a seaside tribe of hot springs and Koholasaurs. Sunny and luck-obsessed, she is also a three-time Night Warden Wars veteran who has never needed resurrection, and bears the Ancient Name Umoja, "unity".

In Chapter V (5.0) she went into the Night Kingdom to rescue her best friend Kachina. There she was acknowledged by her Name and inherited the memories of Tupac, its bearer five hundred years ago. That made her the fourth of the six heroes in the Pyro Archon's plan to end the Abyss's threat to Natlan, which they did in 5.3.

Status as of 7.1: Alive as of 7.1. Since the Abyss war ended (5.3) she has gone back to guiding, surfing and her shop.

She is one of Natlan's six heroes. Atea died shortly after the 5.0 attack on the tribe. With the Ley Lines restored, Natlanese can now leave the nation with their chief's permission; Mualani dreams of Fontaine's great ocean.

71.content:
Nahida (also: Lesser Lord Kusanali, Kusanali, Buer, Dendro Archon, God of Wisdom): Child-like in looks, she spent five centuries confined by the Akademiya's sages, seeing the world only through the Akasha and dreams. Freed with the Traveler's help, she now walks among her people, still learning how to be human and their god.

A god of dreams, minds and metaphors rather than battle, she has saved Sumeru twice: from the sages' false god (3.2) and from Dottore's attack on Irminsul (6.6), which ended with her burning the great tree of the world's memory.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and well in Sumeru City, governing with Grand Sage Naphis. In 6.6 she burned Irminsul to stop Dottore; Aaru now does its work.

Her own link to Irminsul was transposed onto Aaru, so she is safe. She holds no Gnosis; the Tsaritsa holds all but the vanished Pyro Gnosis. She has not gone to Snezhnaya.

72.content:
Navia (also: Navia Caspar, Helm of the Radiant Rose, President of the Spina di Rosula, Demoiselle of the Spina): Second President of the Spina di Rosula, a Fontainian civic group that solves problems the Gardes won't. She inherited it from her father Callas, framed for murder and killed in a duel. Cheerful, theatrical and tireless; fights with a Geo Vision and a jewelled umbrella-gun.

Members call her "Boss". In the Fontaine Archon Quest (4.0-4.2) she cleared her father's name with the Traveler, lost her bodyguards in the Poisson flood, and helped bring the Hydro Archon to trial.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; President of the Spina. As of 7.1 visiting Snezhnograd with Clorinde for Tabletop Troupe.

In 4.3 she stopped Romeuf's faction from bombing the Clementine Line.

key: Owner of the Curatorium of Secrets
73.content:
Nefer (also: Secret Beneath the Sands, Owner of the Curatorium of Secrets, Boss Nefer, Miss Nefer, Lady Nefer, Big Sister Nefer): Owner of Nasha Town's Curatorium of Secrets and head of the Northern Intelligence Network. A desert orphan from Sumeru who out-schemed Nod-Krai's underworld; people half-believe she can see the future.

A key ally in the Song of the Welkin Moon crisis, she read the past of the Wild Hunt's master Rerir and gave up her sight for a time to help defeat him.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, running the Curatorium in Nasha Town as of 7.1; her eyesight has recovered.

After the Welkin Moon crisis she joined the new League's opening. In 6.6 she went to Sumeru with Nicole, freed Thoth, Sobek and Heryshaf, and met Katayoun again.

74.content:
Neuvillette (also: Iudex of Fontaine, Chief Justice of Fontaine, Hydro Dragon Sovereign, Hydro Sovereign, Monsieur Neuvillette, Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment): Few know that the Iudex is the reborn Hydro Dragon Sovereign. Since Furina gave up the Archon's post in 4.2, he has also run the nation.

Status as of 7.1: Alive at 7.1; Iudex and head of Fontaine's government. Furina lives as an ordinary person with his quiet support.

He gave the Hydro Gnosis to Arlecchino (it is now in Fatui hands) and has a standing deal with her: Fatui withdrawal in exchange for leaving ex-House of the Hearth members alone.

75.content:
Nicole (also: Mage N, Memory-Witch, Voiceless Angel, Silent Mage): A former angel of Celestia who gave up her voice to keep a human form. She talks straight into people's minds, and talks a lot. She guides the lost, carves squirrel sculptures and wants to write novels.

For years the Traveler knew her only as a mysterious voice in Sumeru and Fontaine. She met them in person in Nod-Krai (6.2), helped bring the Moon Goddess Columbina home, and in 6.6 helped Sumeru survive Dottore's attack on Irminsul.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and active; not shown in the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya events.

Recent work: the Nod-Krai crisis (6.2-6.3), Witch's Homework duties and the Sumeru Irminsul crisis (6.6).

76.content:
Nilou (also: Star of Zubayr Theater, Dance of Lotuslight): Star dancer of the Zubayr Theater in Sumeru City's Grand Bazaar: otherworldly on stage, sweet and friendly off it. She dances the Dance of Sabzeruz for the Dendro Archon and defends art in a nation that prizes scholarship.

She helped the Traveler break the Akademiya's Sabzeruz dream loop (3.0), played a part in the plot to free Lesser Lord Kusanali (3.2), and led the theater's debate against an Akademiya order to demolish its stage (3.1).

Status as of 7.1: Alive and dancing at the Zubayr Theater. Since the old sages fell, art is no longer suppressed.

The Akademiya's attempt to demolish the stage was defeated, and Inayah has joined the troupe. She remains a central figure of each year's Sabzeruz Festival.

77.content:
Ningguang (also: Tianquan, Lady Tianquan, Eclipsing Star, Lady of the Jade Chamber, Tailor of Liyue): Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing, which governs Liyue now that Rex Lapis is gone: keeper of its laws and foreign relations, and by repute the wealthiest person in Teyvat. Born poor, she built her fortune herself. She lives in the Jade Chamber, a floating palace she once dropped onto an ancient god to save the city, then rebuilt.

Rumours about her are everywhere and rarely agree.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and still Tianquan as of 7.1; the Jade Chamber, rebuilt in 2.4, floats again.

She played no part in the Nod-Krai or Snezhnaya Archon Quests.

78.content:
Noelle (also: Maid of Favonius, Chivalric Blossom, Wondermaid, Maid Knight): The maid of the Knights of Favonius, helping anyone who calls her name. She dreams of becoming a real knight, has failed the selection several times, and keeps training. Small and polite, she is enormously strong.

Mondstadters call her the "Wondermaid" because she seems to be everywhere at once; she says she just does her job properly.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt City; still the Knights' maid, not yet knighted as of 7.1, training for her next selection.

Jean now coaches her swordwork, and Grand Master Varka, home from Nod-Krai, means to teach her a trick or two.

key: Prima Ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe
79.content:
Odette (also: Odette Spessiva, Lelek, Swirling Snow, Prima Ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe): Prima ballerina of Snezhnograd's Korolevskiy Troupe and a Fatuus trained as a child by Signora. Until 7.0 she was secretly "Lelek", the Rokot's most notorious agent. She is cool, terse, overbooked, and rumoured heir to Signora's title.

Audiences queue for her precision, not her warmth: she rarely smiles at the curtain call and leaves by the side door. Dance by day, Fatui work by night; every hour is filled, so grief has no room.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Snezhnograd at 7.1: still prima and a Fatuus, exposed as Lelek and suspended from the Rokot.

After the Armory Palace break-in, the Rokot got her penalties waived but retired the codename Lelek and suspended her; she may earn a new one. At Signora's tomb she danced, shattered her Cor Ignis and chose to go on as ballerina and Fatuus. Project Stuzha is suspended.

80.content:
Ororon (also: Bidii, Shadow of the Night-Wind, Shrouded Bat of Mictlan, Orasha): A Masters of the Night-Wind foundling with an incomplete soul who lives alone with his vegetables and Phlogiston Aphids. In the war with the Abyss he first aided the Fatui's Captain, then became the fifth of Natlan's six heroes.

Calm and often cryptic, he rarely means anything deep by it. Underneath, he has long wanted his life to be worth something.

Status as of 7.1: Alive at home in Natlan as of 7.1, bearer of Bidii. The war with the Abyss is over; the Captain gave his life to merge with the Lord of the Night.

He has decided to live for a purpose: "I want to be someone who can help Natlan."

81.content:
Prune (also: Witch Hunter, Little Witch Hunter, little witch Prune): A fiercely serious child from Nasha Town, Nod-Krai. The mage Alice "kidnapped" her imaginary puppy Descartes, so she came to Mondstadt for revenge and became the reluctant best friend of Alice's daughter Klee. She insists she is no longer a kid.

Mondstadt answers her furious notices with kind smiles and discount coupons.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt City as of 7.1, living with a relative (curfew included). Still officially hunting Alice; Klee's friend.

Since a limited-time 6.6 event she belongs to the Little Hexenzirkel, and Descartes is back.

82.content:
Qiqi (also: Fortune Preserver, Maiden of Resurrection, Icy Resurrection, Little Witch Qiqi): Bubu Pharmacy's zombie apprentice: a mortal herb-picker killed centuries ago in a clash between adepti and demons, revived by the adepti, and frozen in a child's form. She lives by self-given "orders" and a notebook.

Deadpan and absent-minded on the surface, she is polite, conscientious, much stronger than she looks, and fiercely wants to live.

Status as of 7.1: Undead but active at Bubu Pharmacy in Liyue Harbor as of 7.1; the adeptal sigil holding her soul together is weakening.

Zibai (6.4) found fetor from Lantern Rite (5.3) had greatly depleted it; barely a tenth of its original power remains, and adepti are looking into it.

83.content:
Raiden Shogun (also: Ei, Raiden Ei, Beelzebul, Baal, Electro Archon, God of Eternity, Almighty Shogun, Narukami Ogosho): Inazuma's Electro Archon is two beings in one body: Raiden Ei, a warrior goddess who once sealed herself away to pursue an unchanging "Eternity", and the Shogun, the puppet she built to rule for her. Since the Traveler defeated her, Ei rules more openly.

Publicly she is simply the Raiden Shogun, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho. Few know the god now sampling dango in Inazuma City is Ei, once her twin sister's double.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, ruling from Tenshukaku. The decrees are gone and the borders open; Ei now takes the body out often to see her nation. The Shogun serves as her kagemusha.

Her Gnosis went via Yae to Scaramouche, then Nahida, then Dottore; the Fatui now hold it. Ei has not appeared in the Nod-Krai or Snezhnaya chapters.

84.content:
Razor (also: Wolf Boy, Legend of Wolvendom): Razor is a boy raised from infancy by the wolf pack of Boreas, the Wolf of the North, in Wolvendom. He hunts with them, fights with a claymore and an Electro Vision, and calls the family he chose his "Lupical". He is still learning to speak and live among humans.

Grand Master Varka first drew him toward the human world, and the librarian Lisa now teaches him. Mondstadt knows him only by rumour, as the "Wolf Boy". Some say he is an orphan, others a wolf spirit in human form. He keeps asking himself whether he is a human or a wolf, and has decided he is happy either way.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and well in Wolvendom with his pack as of 7.1. He still hunts, guards the forest and visits his friends in Mondstadt.

Varka, the man he most wanted to see, has come home from the Nod-Krai expedition. Razor was among those waiting at Windrise to welcome him.

85.content:
Rosaria (also: Sister Rosaria, Thorny Benevolence): A Church of Favonius sister in name only, Rosaria skips prayers and vanishes for days. In those absences she works alone at night, investigating suspicious strangers and quietly removing real threats to Mondstadt. Raised by bandits and given a second chance by Grand Master Varka, she sees herself as a creature of the dark guarding a city of sunlight.

Most Mondstadters see only the lazy, chain-smoking nun; Kaeya, Diluc, Dahlia and the Traveler know she is ruthless, professional and, under the ice, protective.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and in Mondstadt as of 7.1, still a Church sister by day and the city's quiet enforcer by night.

In 6.4 she received and answered Varka's letter from the Nod-Krai expedition, and was among the friends whose replies helped guide him home.

86.content:
Sandrone (also: Marionette, Lady Marionette, Marionette Guillotin, The Seventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, Her Highness the Clockwork Princess, Unraveller of All Reason): A Fontainian automaton who sees the world through mathematics and never misses a tea party. Killed by Dottore in Nod-Krai and revived, she is back at work in Snezhnograd as of 7.1.

She heads the Armory Palace's engineering and co-oversees the Adventurers' Guild. Snezhnayans call her "the Lady" and speak of her with fear, but also respect. To friends she is Sandrone, a name they link with pastries, the tick of her mainspring and her outbursts.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Snezhnograd (7.1). Died in Nod-Krai (6.3), revived in Fontaine (6.7); Pulonia was lost.

Fagio now accompanies her.
A fail-safe Alain hid in her core, triggered by a Stellar Linchpin that appeared at her side, brought her back. The Tsaritsa offered her "post-mortem leave"; she chose to stay, to the disappointment of those who had carved up her power and interests after her death, including a "certain someone" eyeing the Adventurers' Guild.

87.content:
Sangonomiya Kokomi (also: Kokomi, Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island, Her Excellency Sangonomiya, Sole of the Deep): She organised and commanded Watatsumi's resistance and won by strategy, not numbers. In private she is a shy, easily drained homebody who would rather be an adviser reading military books.

Her people say "Never fear, Her Excellency Sangonomiya is here". She keeps a calm, smiling public face and hides her tiredness; a secret notebook records what each day cost her.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and governing Watatsumi in peacetime. The Vision Hunt and Sakoku Decrees are long over; Watatsumi is at peace with the Shogunate.

At the 2.1 peace talks she agreed fishing and protection terms with Kujou Sara, insisted on a trade council with merchants from both sides, and kept her army under her own command while the Tenryou Commission dealt with Fatui-linked traitors. She founded a new Secret Corps for island security.

88.content:
Sayu (also: Mujina Ninja, Shuumatsuban's Resident Ninja, Master Sayu, Little Witch Sayu): Sayu is a pint-sized ninja of the Shuumatsuban, the secret unit of Inazuma's Yashiro Commission. She is famous for laziness: she uses escape and disguise ninjutsu to dodge work and nap, convinced that sleep will finally make her grow taller.

Beneath the naps she is loyal, kind to the weak and capable when it counts; she stole the evidence that helped end the Vision Hunt Decree. Her sensei left her years ago, and the shrine maiden Kano Nana now hunts her down for training.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and active in Inazuma as of 7.1, still a Shuumatsuban ninja, still napping, still not taller.

She has no part in the Nod-Krai or Snezhnaya Archon Quests. Kano Nana now manages her stipend.

89.content:
Sethos (also: Wisdom's Measure, Desert Envoy, Lord Sethos, Green-Eyed Desert Guy): A cheerful desert youth who runs errands and guides travellers in Sumeru City. In truth he leads the Temple of Silence, the secretive order guarding King Deshret's knowledge, and was a vessel of Hermanubis until he lost a sacred duel to Cyno.

He keeps both lives on purpose: a well-liked newcomer who knows everyone, and the heir of a grandfather who carried the burden of bloodshed.

Status as of 7.1: Alive. Leads the Temple of Silence near Thamud Oasis while living incognito in Sumeru City. The Temple now works with the Akademiya again.

He no longer carries a Ba fragment; Cyno holds both. He is on close terms with Cyno, Tighnari and their friends and is known around the city as a friendly newcomer.

90.content:
Shenhe (also: Divine Damsel of Devastation, Miss Crane, White-haired adeptus, Lonesome Transcendence): A human raised by the adepti. As a child she survived her father's attempt to sacrifice her to a monster; Cloud Retainer took her in, and her soul is bound with red ropes to restrain a violent, ill-fated nature. She now works at Wanmin Restaurant in Liyue Harbor.

People keep calling her an adeptus, or a witch; she insists she is only a disciple.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Liyue Harbor as of 7.1, working as a server at Wanmin Restaurant; still bound by the red ropes.

She has had no part in the Nod-Krai or Snezhnaya crises.

91.content:
Shikanoin Heizou (also: Heizou, Doushin Shikanoin, Detective Heizou, Analytical Harmony, Detective of the Tenryou Commission): The Tenryou Commission's star detective: a lowly Doushin who skips patrols yet cracks the cases no one else can, by intuition, "keyword" memory and meticulous logic. Cheerful and cheeky, he wants his name alone to scare would-be criminals off.

Inmates of the Police Station Jail call him "Cyclone".

Status as of 7.1: Alive; Tenryou Commission Doushin-detective. Last seen (6.0) in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai, chasing an Inazuman fugitive.

He serves under Kujou Sara at the Police Station, still a Doushin, still famous among inmates, still skipping patrols. The Commission has been reshuffled since Kujou Takayuki's fall, and Heizou notes it has grown more efficient since Kujou Kamaji took office.

92.content:
Sigewinne (also: Nurse Sigewinne, Head Nurse Sigewinne, Melusine Head Nurse, Wondrous Dragonheir): A Melusine, child of the dragon Elynas, who took a human face and hands long ago to save a sick friend. She was imprisoned for it under an ancient law, served her time and stayed on. Inmates and guards call her their angel.

Her infirmary never closes. She treats everyone, by persuasion, by trickery or, if she must, with a tranquilizer dart.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; still head nurse of the Fortress as of 7.1, by choice.

She knows her teacher's sacrifice and refused a potion that would restore her old form.

93.content:
Skirk (also: Void Star, Sinner's Pupil, Fool's Master, Childe's master): A swordswoman from another planet who lives mostly in the Abyss and disguises its power as Cryo. Disciple of Surtalogi "The Foul" of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah; master of the young Tartaglia. She lives to grow strong enough to face her master, who has promised to return and destroy all she has.

She appeared in Fontaine's Primordial Sea in 4.2 to collect her master's pet, the All-Devouring Narwhal, and in Liyue in 5.7 she mended the Traveler's torn soul and confronted a thief of divine power.

Status as of 7.1: Alive as of 7.1, wandering Teyvat and training mostly in the Abyss; absent from the Snezhnaya Archon Quest.

Her last story appearance was in Nod-Krai (6.0), selling Radiant Exoskeletons to Dori in Nasha Town. She took half the 6,000,000 Mora offered and had the rest given to the Traveler as supplies. Then she left through a rift.

94.content:
Sucrose (also: Harmless Sweetie): Sucrose is Albedo's assistant in the Knights of Favonius and a gifted bio-alchemist: she modifies existing plants and creatures rather than creating new life. She is painfully shy with people and fearless with experiments. Secretly she is trying to build the fairy-tale paradise she dreamed of as a child.

Her results are real (Sweet Flowers with 70% more nectar, Sunsettias that stay fresh for a month), but to her they are only steps along the way.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and working in Mondstadt as Albedo's assistant. As of 7.1 she has no part in the Snezhnaya events.

In 6.6 she was testing the Simulation Training Bubble: Type 02, adapted from Alice's memory magic, for the Investigation Team. She was also in Mondstadt for Collei's visit.

95.content:
Tartaglia (also: Childe, Ajax, Eleventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, Councilor Tartaglia, Master of Weaponry): The Eleventh and youngest Fatui Harbinger: a cheerful, reckless warrior who lives for strong opponents. Since Capitano's will (7.0) he commands most of the Captain's troops and speaks for the armed forces in the Snezhnograd Veche.

He helped, deceived and fought the Traveler in Liyue, lost, and has wanted a rematch ever since. His youngest brother thinks he sells toys.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Snezhnaya at 7.1: a Veche councilor commanding Capitano's former troops, praised by the Tsaritsa, overworked, and still waiting for a rematch with the Traveler.

He privately opposed Project Stuzha but did not vote against it. After Pierro put it on hold, the Veche grew calmer. He arranged the Traveler's audience with the Tsaritsa (7.1) and voted to unseal Hroptatyr's notebook.

96.content:
Thoma (also: Protector From Afar, Kamisato Clan's Housekeeper, Yashiro Commission housekeeper): The cheerful housekeeper and quiet "fixer" of the Kamisato Clan, which runs Inazuma's Yashiro Commission. Raised in Mondstadt, he washed up in Inazuma penniless and has stood by the Kamisato siblings ever since out of loyalty.

He was the Traveler's first guide in Inazuma and nearly the 100th victim of the Vision Hunt Decree, until the Traveler interrupted the ceremony.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Inazuma, still serving the Kamisato Clan; the decrees are over and he kept his Vision.

In 5.7 he visited Mondstadt on leave after his mother Ulrike was posted to Varka's expedition in Nod-Krai; by early 2026 (6.2-era letter) he was back in Inazuma.

97.content:
Tighnari (also: Forest Watcher Tighnari, Avidya Forest Watcher, Verdant Strider, Master Tighnari, General Watchleader): Forest Watcher of Avidya Forest and de facto head of the Forest Rangers at Gandharva Ville. He is an Amurta-trained botanist who turned down academia, Collei's mentor and Cyno's close friend. Inherited Tighnarian traits give him large ears and a tail.

He fixes problems fast and lectures whoever caused them. He sided with the Traveler and the Dendro Archon against the Akademiya's god-making plot (3.0-3.2).

Status as of 7.1: Alive and at work in Avidya Forest as of 7.1. Collei is now a full Forest Ranger.

After the 6.6 Irminsul crisis he graduated Collei and briefly visited Mondstadt with her and Cyno. He plays no part in the 7.0-7.1 Snezhnaya story.

98.content:
Traveler (also: Aether, Lumine, Honorary Knight, Windborne Outlander, Tumaini, Fourth Descender, Hero of Liyue): The protagonist, sealed by a god during the Cataclysm and woken 500 years later, who has crossed every nation with Paimon looking for their twin, now leader of the Abyss Order. As of 7.1 they are in Snezhnaya, uneasily allied with the Tsaritsa.

Gods and Harbingers know them as a Descender, not fully bound by Teyvat's rules; ordinary people know a quiet adventurer who keeps ending up at the centre of each nation's crisis.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Snezhnograd (7.1); secret Rokot member. After Ronova's defeat the Tsaritsa respects them. Their twin is still out of reach.

The Tsaritsa ended all investigations into them and wants to work with them. They sided with Snezhnaya mainly to keep Paimon from Ronova. With Ronova fallen, the anti-Celestia Project Mistilteinn can resume.

99.content:
Varesa (also: Masked Hero, Inferno Stomach Supremo): Gentle, sleepy orchard owner and near-unmatched wrestler of the Collective of Plenty's Patrol Team. Eats for dozens, loves hero comics, and has long relied on a mask modelled on the heroine Fietena for courage.

Children call her the "Masked Hero"; neighbours know the cheerful voice calling "Fresh produce from Varesa's!" from her fruit cart.

Status as of 7.1: Alive at home in the Collective of Plenty after Natlan's victory over the Abyss: orchard, fruit cart, training, Patrol Team.

Since 5.5 she keeps watch over the weakened mushroom god Bifrons, and is still learning to fight without her mask.

100.content:
Varka (also: Grand Master Varka, Knight of Boreas, Mightiest Knight of Boreas, Invincible Knight of Boreas, Grand Master Who Rivals the Gods, Uncle Varka): Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius and Knight of Boreas, Mondstadt's link to the wolf god of the North Wind. A huge, laughing, wine-loving man who hates paperwork, and the strongest knight in generations. His long expedition north ended in the Nod-Krai crisis; he is home again.

He had no noble blood or divine favour, only stubborn effort; the omens bards attach to his birth are inventions. Jean ran Mondstadt in his absence.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, back in Mondstadt as Grand Master after the expedition. A small Knights garrison remains at Favonius Keep in Nod-Krai.
